uncertain_terms.note: Doc-number mismatch: the manifest doc number is OFR-002-R0A, but this page is an index of 27 protection documents; OFR-002-r0a is only the first row listed. Title taken from the page heading "Protection Devices".
Suspect value: the under-frequency protection device is also labelled (81H) in the source; the standard ANSI code for under-frequency is 81U. Kept verbatim.
